sentences.12.4 Vi må prøve å spise sunt: 12.4 We must try to eat healthily
sentences.Marit og Håvard har vært på joggetur sam: Marit and Håvard have been for a jog together.
sentences.Nå har de dusjet, og Håvard er kjempesul: Now they have showered, and Håvard is starving.
sentences.Skal vi bestille en pizza? Jeg er både s: Shall we order a pizza? I'm both tired and hungry. I can't face making dinner now.
sentences.Jeg synes at vi skal prøve å spise sunne: I think we should try to eat more healthily. Pizza is unhealthy. I can make carrot soup with homemade wholemeal rolls.
I think this soup will fill you up.
sentences.Marit og Håvard sitter ved bordet og spi: Marit and Håvard are sitting at the table eating.
sentences.Hva synes du? Er suppa god?: What do you think? Is the soup good?
sentences.Mm, og disse rundstykkene er også veldig: Mm, and these rolls are very good too. I'll have one more. Ow!
sentences.Jeg fikk så vondt i ei tann. Jeg må ring: I got such a pain in a tooth. I have to ring the dentist, because I think the tooth is broken. It hurts so much. I hope I get an appointment tomorrow.
sentences.Marit og Håvard har vært på den første j: Marit and Håvard have been on their first jog together, and now they are going to have dinner.
sentences.Håvard spør om de skal bestille en pizza: Håvard asks if they should order a pizza, but Marit wants to make healthy food.
sentences.De spiser gulrotsuppe med hjemmelagde ru: They eat carrot soup with homemade rolls.
sentences.Håvard synes at suppa er god, og han spi: Håvard thinks the soup is good, and he eats lots of rolls.
sentences.Han tror at tanna er ødelagt, og sier at: He thinks the tooth is broken, and says that he has to ring the dentist.
sentences.Det er viktig å spise sunn mat og unngå: It is important to eat healthy food and avoid eating too much unhealthy food.
sentences.Vi kan legge på oss av å spise mat som i: We can put on weight from eating food that contains a lot of sugar.
Being overweight can lead to type 2 diabetes.
It is healthy to eat vegetables and fruit.
sentences.Vi bør spise grønnsaker og frukt hver da: We should eat vegetables and fruit every day.
Vitamin D is important for the body.
sentences.Vi får vitamin D fra sola, men fra oktob: We get vitamin D from the sun, but from October to April this is not enough.
sentences.Da er det mindre sol i Norge enn i sydli: Then there is less sun in Norway than in countries further south.
sentences.Om vinteren bør vi ta tran og spise fet: In the winter we should take cod liver oil and eat oily fish, because there is no vitamin D in fruit and vegetables.
